observations.trace: detect_from_code scans every source byte for #version, returns allocated glsl or wgsl strings, and parse_naga rematches it. ComputeShader repeats the detection. Kernel::new documents ordinary WGSL and accepts source text without an explicit language argument. A WGSL line comment containing #version satisfies the first substring branch, although pinned Naga source identifies ordinary comments as trivia.
observations.remaining: Earlier historical delegate749 already raised this exact conditional case. This demonstrates source branch selection, not a parser result or an observed failure; supported inputs, caller provenance and chosen language policy remain open.

observations.trace: Current GLSL parse errors are debug-formatted; WGSL ParseError is rendered to a diagnostic string. Pinned Naga GLSL ParseErrors owns ErrorKind and span; WGSL ParseError exposes message and labels. ComputeShader adds another textual parse context.
observations.remaining: Original q360 and q361 preserve separate native parser causes; existing downstream policy, aliases and source retention remain open. No shader parsing occurred.

observations.trace: Context opening drops four distinct browser canvas, browser surface, adapter and device causes with wildcard map_err. Pinned web-sys OffscreenCanvas returns JsValue; pinned wgpu exposes CreateSurfaceError, RequestAdapterError and RequestDeviceError. submitted_work_done discards native device.poll Result and returns unit; browser callback cancellation returns unit.
observations.remaining: Historic q159 remains the parent, and q362–365 retain their exact original aliases to four distinct q2269–2272 subcontracts. Completion semantics and browser JsValue transport remain policy questions. No native request or polling executed.

observations.trace: PassParameters public IndexMap, insert and From retain arbitrary shader names; existing consumers rematch reflected names. From<i32> casts to u32, and both ComputePass and fast cached writer emit the u32 little-endian bytes. For -1, the selected conversion yields FFFFFFFF, the same 32-bit two-complement representation as i32 -1. The separate bind helper ignores its Unsigned variant through a wildcard, leaving zero-initialized bytes.
observations.remaining: Earlier delegate749 already identified the signed/unsigned representation as a numeric policy question. Byte parity alone does not prove every shader kind or consumer safe; q151 ABI and q317/2331 native name admission remain open. No product execution.

observations.trace: Public WgpuContext::from_parts accepts instance, adapter, device and queue as independent Arc values and stores them without an explicit same-device check. Public fields also remain independently replaceable.
observations.remaining: Earlier delegate750 already noted this possibility. Actual producers, native handle compatibility and whether the API promises admission of arbitrary combinations remain open; no mismatch was supplied or backend invoked.
